title: Jubilant Juicy Venezuelan Cheese Sandwich
description: A savory and chewy lacto-vegetarian-friendly Venezuelan dish featuring wholegrain bread and served on a talavera plate, perfect for a crowd-pleasing snack
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat
Butter one side of each bread slice
Place one bread slice, butter-side down, in the skillet
Spread a layer of mayonnaise on top of the bread slice in the skillet
Crumble queso fresco over the mayonnaise layer
Sprinkle chopped cilantro, salt, and black pepper over the cheese
Place another bread slice, butter-side up, on top of the filling
Brush the edges of the bread with whisked egg for a golden glaze
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted
Carefully flip the sandwich over and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown
